title: Group Term Life and Personal Accident Insurance

sections.html:
Group Term Life and Personal Accident Insurance

Your employees are the backbone of your business. Offering them protection against accidents demonstrates you value their well-being. Show your team you’ve got their back—on and off the job.

Group Term Life and Group Personal Accident Insurance provide essential financial security in times of unexpected loss or injury.

At Trinity, we offer comprehensive Group Term Life and Group Personal Accident Insurance, a yearly renewable insurance. It pays the face amount of the policy in case a member of the group dies due to natural and accidental causes within the coverage period (term). This policy likewise indemnifies the insured in case of permanent disability or dismemberment.

What is the information needed for Group Term Life and Group Personal Accident Insurance?
• With Existing Plan:
o Company Name
o Nature of Business
o Location
o Copy of the contract/schedule of benefits
o Utilization report
o List of employees and dependents with date of birth, civil status, gender, amount of insurance, position/job level
o Nature of business
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity

• Virgin Account:
o Company Name
o Nature of Business
o Location
o Preferred plan benefits, if possible
o List of employees and dependents with date of birth, civil status, gender, position/job level
o Nature of business
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
